internal_balancing_resistance_ohm.conditions: RDS(ON) for internal FET switch at VVC(n) - VVC(n-1) = 1.5 V, 1 <= n <= 16, VBAT >= 4.7 V

maximum_balancing_current_per_cell_a.conditions: Maximum cell balancing current through a single cell VC0 - VC16: 100 mA

statements.text: Cell balancing must be controlled to limit the current based on the absolute maximum allowed current, and to avoid exceeding the recommended device operating temperature. This can be accomplished by appropriate sizing of the offchip cell input resistors and limiting the number of cells that can be balanced simultaneously.

The BQ76952 device supports passive cell balancing by bypassing the current of a selected cell during charging or at rest, using either integrated bypass switches between cells, or external bypass FET switches.
